title: In 2026, researchers compared ancient and modern bison DNA, finding genetic diversity survived the population collapse
description: Ancient DNA from bison bones suggests the 19th-century collapse did not erase the species’ genetic diversity, offering hope for herd recovery.

title: India and Sri Lanka Launch SAMHiTA Manuscript Digitisation Project to Preserve Ancient Buddhist Heritage
description: The Gangaramaya Temple in Colombo has become the first Sri Lankan institution to collaborate with the SAMHiTA initiative. The partnership focuses on preserving valuable manuscripts that document religious traditions, philosophy, languages and cultural practices developed and transmitted across generations. title: His Majesty launches an ancient tradition into a new era
description: The echoes of Om Mani Padme Hung that resound over the hills and valleys of Bhutan will now reverberate around the digital world. And digital chyem (rosary), on the screen, ensures consistent and accurate recitation of the chant,preserving an accurate lifetime count. In today’s screen-age, the spiritual practice of Yoeja has moved online, with the times.
